facts.fact: Law 103-12 on credit institutions, enacted by Dahir 1-14-193 of 24 December 2014 and given here as amended, defines payment means including electronic money (Article 6) and payment services (Article 16), and regulates payment institutions (Articles 15-18) as binding law.
facts.system: Loi n° 103-12 relative aux établissements de crédit et organismes assimilés

facts.fact: Law 103-12 (2014) defines payment institutions (établissements de paiement) as entities offering payment services, separate from credit institutions, and requires them to obtain Bank Al-Maghrib approval before operating in Morocco (Article 34).
facts.system: Loi n° 103-12 relative aux établissements de crédit et organismes assimilés

note: No rule requiring payment providers to connect to each other is stated in the text read.
